name: Anjo Nala
bio: Archetype: Binding, Ultimate Cycle, Extra Action, Crowd-Control. ⌽ Has Moxie consumption of 8 and limit of 12. ⌽ Beginning of stage: Chooses one ally to designate as "the Bound". All Moxie the Bound gains is transferred to Anjo Nala. ⌽ Ult causes both to Channel, releasing both Ults consecutively the following turn at the cost of 50% of the Bound's current HP. ⌽ Additional effects triggered based on the afflatus of the Bound: ⌽ Beast/Plant: Gains Moxie when the Bound consumes AP. ⌽ Star/Mineral: AoE extra action when the Bound consumes AP. ⌽ Spirit/Intellect: S1 extra action used against lowest HP enemy when the Bound consumes AP. This decreases S2 countdown.
